output.body: Every recursive function needs a base case, the input it answers directly, and a recursive case, where it calls itself on a smaller input. Isomorph: sum(n) = n + sum(n-1) with base case sum(1) = 1, so sum(3) needs 3 + sum(2), which forces sum(2) = 2 + sum(1) = 3, giving sum(3) = 3 + 3 = 6. Each call shrinks the input until the base case stops the chain.
